about: The priest asks the Holy Trinity to receive the offering made in memory of Christ's passion, resurrection and ascension, and in honor of the Blessed Virgin Mary and the saints. In the final petition, their intercession in heaven corresponds to the keeping of their memory on earth.

seg.nr: At the middle of the altar, the priest bows slightly and rests his joined hands upon it.

seg.tr: Holy Trinity, receive this offering, which we present to You in remembrance of the Passion, Resurrection, and Ascension of Jesus Christ our Lord, and in honor of blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, these saints, and all the saints. May it bring them honor and us salvation; and may those whom we commemorate on earth deign to intercede for us in heaven. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

ex.w021: “Ob memóriam” refers to Christ, while “in honórem” refers to the saints.
